title: Research: lancedb vector search for craftegy-design
description:
WHAT: Evaluate lancedb and alternatives for semantic search over design artifacts in craftegy-design

acceptance_criteria:

notes: Research completed 2026-05-10. Recommendation: DEFER vector search. LanceDB has native Rust SDK (v0.27.2) but is overkill for craftegy-design's scale (<1K artifacts). Brute-force cosine similarity over SQLite BLOBs handles the expected volume in <1ms. Graduation path: SQLite BLOBs -> sqlite-vec -> usearch. hora is unmaintained (2021). Embedding strategy: reuse BYOK provider for remote embeddings, plan ort/fastembed for offline mode. Reports: docs/research/craftegy-design-vector-db-spike.md, docs/research/craftegy-design-db-selection.md

## Full Context: VS-Powered Retroduce

### Current State
retroduce generates hypotheses ONLY from KB rules via backward chaining + MDL scoring.
Limited to what rules can express.

### With VS
retroduce_vs(observation, k=5):
1. VS generates k candidate explanations with p(h_i)
2. Each candidate -> infer Hypothesis { text, confidence: p_i, source: "vs" }
3. Rule-driven retroduce also generates hypotheses { ..., source: "mdl" }
4. Merge ranking: mdl_score * vs_probability -> unified ordering
5. Return top-N with proof trees (rule) or rationale (VS)

### Integration
New infer-vs crate or module in infer-abduction:
- Accepts VS JSON output (list of {text, probability})
- Converts to Hypothesis structs
- Dual scorer merges MDL + VS rankings
- AAF evaluates conflicts between rule-derived and VS-derived
- Output feeds pctl-rs via infer-pctl bridge

title: [pctl-rs] Inductive Stress-Test for VS Hypotheses — Belnap Interval Verification
description: Stress-test VS-generated hypotheses via probabilistic model checking with Belnap interval semantics. VS claims p(h)=0.7, pctl-rs verifies actual interval [lo,hi] from evidence sources. Calibration delta feeds back to criterium. GitHub: zombocoder/pctl-rs#26
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] verify_vs_hypothesis() compares VS probability against computed Belnap interval
- [ ] Calibration delta computed (VS claimed vs actual midpoint)
- [ ] Batch verification: process k VS hypotheses against shared evidence sources
- [ ] Output includes Belnap truth value + interval + calibration feedback
- [ ] NINE bilattice path: VS hypothesis gets F-G-R provenance for quality-weighted composition

comments.author: root
comments.text:
## Full Context: Inductive VS Verification

### Role
VS claims p(h)=0.7. Is that grounded in evidence?
pctl-rs builds DTMC from evidence sources, computes P(h) = [lo, hi].

Belnap semantics:
  lo >= threshold    -> True (all sources confirm)
  hi < threshold     -> False (all sources reject)
  lo < t <= hi       -> Conflicted (sources disagree)
  no source data     -> Unknown

### Calibration Feedback
calibration_delta = vs_probability - interval.midpoint()
  Consistent positive -> VS overconfident -> reduce calibration_factor
  Consistent negative -> VS underconfident -> increase
  Near-zero -> VS well-calibrated for this domain

### NINE Bilattice Integration
VS source gets F-G-R scores:
  formality=low (LLM opinion, not formal proof)
  generality=high (model-agnostic)
  reliability=from_calibration_delta
Same-tier composition resolves conflicts per ADR-006.

### Key Files
- crates/pctl-belnap/ (BelnapDtmc, interval composition)
- crates/pctl-core/ (DTMC/MDP types)
- ADR-006 (NINE same-tier composition)

comments.text:
## Spike: pctl-rs as calibration ground truth (from docs/research/vs-probability-calibration-spike.md)

pctl-rs computes actual [lo,hi] intervals = ground truth for measuring VS ECE.
Enables adaptive cal: cal_next = max(0.5, 1 - ECE_measured_by_pctl).
This is the feedback loop that makes VS self-correcting over time.

## Full Context: VS Abduction Front-End

### Paper
Verbalized Sampling (Zhang et al., Stanford+CMU, arXiv 2510.01171)
Training-free prompting: ask LLM to generate k candidates with probability estimates instead of single answer.
2-3x diversity improvement while maintaining quality.

### Architecture
criterium-hitl -> VS prompt (k=7 hypotheses)
  -> each h_i gets (text, p_i)
  -> convert p_i to DS interval [Bel_i, Pl_i]
  -> feed into criterium-core session
  -> deduction validates (infer), induction stress-tests (pctl-rs)
  -> criterion-driven collapse

### VS -> DS Mapping
Bel(h) = p(h) * calibration_factor
Pl(h) = 1 - (1 - p(h)) * calibration_factor
Where calibration_factor accounts for VS self-rating accuracy.

### Implementation
Python VS lib: from verbalized_sampling import verbalize
dist = verbalize(prompt, k=5, tau=0.10, temperature=0.9)
result = dist.sample(seed=42)
